name: 夕阳三-炎龙美化版
group_note: 夕阳三-炎龙美化版 (夕阳再现III 之 炎龙封印, AKAI Studio). Same 'version '/'2060' Tomud client-handshake gate as the xyj2006 family (first reply must be the literal '2060'). Registration has no 'new' keyword (any fresh id -> y/n new-character confirm, matching xyj451); gift stats are a menu-driven pick (1-4 to customize one attribute, 0 for a random set, then y/n to accept). WASM pass caught proactively via scripts/lib_bulk_fix.py + scripts/scan_known_bugs.py before the first boot test: the standard §8.1 check_legal_name() i%2 parity gate/[i..<0] suffix slice (is_chinese() itself was already the correct per-codepoint form) fixed to name[i..i]; master.lpc's valid_read()/valid_write() lacked a 'user == this_object()' short-circuit (added proactively, alongside this lib's own partial pre-existing guard via previous_object()) -- same latent risk that silently killed every registration on xyj20032. adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc (the active DNS_MASTER, confirmed via net/daemons.h) is already commented out of preload (pre-existing, dormant) -- a dead unreferenced sibling adm/daemons/dns_master.lpc also has raw socket calls but is never loaded. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (SECURITY_D correctly points at securityd.lpc, which genuinely reads WIZLIST -- the alternate 'securd' path in globals.h is commented out, no §7.56 ambiguity here). Registration verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: version handshake (2060) -> English id -> y (confirm new character) -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> 0 (random gift stats) -> y (accept) -> email -> gender (m/f) -> enters world at 客店, look/score both clean. Admin permission confirmed via '您目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 8302 .lpc files (8205 written, 64 pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock content-file errors left unformatted -- a messier codebase than most in this batch -- 33 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits; one CJK-respacing hit (d/city/sj.lpc) confirmed as the same pre-existing missing-quote corruption seen on tybxjh/xhcii's sibling file and reverted; two case-label-with-trailing-comment hits (cmds/bakcmds/csc.lpc, cmds/bakcmds/meskills.lpc, both dead backup-command copies) diff-reviewed clean. Post-formatter re-verified clean, admin permission still (admin).
